# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss

## Appearance

She is a bright, ladylike young woman with a sweet voice. She has lovely fair curly hair, fascinating eyes, and dresses beautifully, wearing sleeve puffs larger than anyone else in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a sympathetic, wholesome influence who wins and holds the affection of her pupils, bringing out the best in them mentally and morally. She possesses tactful, careful, and broadminded guidance that leads her class to think, explore, and discover for themselves. She is an encouraging teacher who trains her students to be their own severest critics.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P13](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0013), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy is engaged as the new teacher for Avonlea school, becoming the first female teacher the community has ever had. She introduces various new educational methods, such as physical culture exercises, bi-weekly recitation and dialogue afternoons, and 'field' afternoons in the woods to study nature and write compositions. In the fall, she organizes a successful student concert to raise money for a schoolhouse flag. She encourages Anne Shirley in her studies and compositions, and later forms an advanced class after school to prepare interested students for the entrance examination into Queen's Academy. Though offered a position in her home district's grade school, she decides to remain in Avonlea to see her students through their preparation. She drills her entrance class thoroughly through the following school year, after which she leaves her rule at Avonlea school at the end of June when her pupils take their examinations.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Was hired by the Avonlea school trustees as the first female teacher in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- Was offered a position in the grade school of her own home district  <sub>[v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> I thought of taking another school, but I have decided to come back to Avonlea. To tell the truth, I’ve grown so interested in my pupils here that I found I couldn’t leave them. So I’ll stay and see you through.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

> But you’ve done good work this past year, and you deserve a good, jolly vacation. Have the best time you can in the out-of-door world and lay in a good stock of health and vitality and ambition to carry you through next year. It will be the tug of war, you know—the last year before the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
